beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until BERT unlocks 80.5% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A linear sequence of tokens moving left to right with a vertical wall blocking forward vision.

visual_blueprint.title: THE LINEAR LIMITATION
visual_blueprint.sub: Predictive models are constrained by causal left-to-right temporal masks

motif_params.title: THE LINEAR LIMITATION
motif_params.sub: Predictive models are constrained by causal left-to-right temporal masks

beats.text: This directional dependency is a massive performance cage, preventing the network from understanding the deeper structural context of a full sentence.
beats.visual_focus: A rigid geometric wireframe of a sentence where connections only flow in one direction, creating a bottleneck.

visual_blueprint.title: THE CAUSAL BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Unidirectional attention artificially limits the receptive field

motif_params.title: THE CAUSAL BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Unidirectional attention artificially limits the receptive field

beats.text: BERT shatters this by introducing the Cloze task, randomly masking 15 percent of tokens to force simultaneous, deep bidirectional attention.
beats.visual_focus: A sentence of tokens where random ones are highlighted and obscured, triggering a bidirectional flow of attention weights.

beats.text: The encoder processes this corrupted input globally, utilizing the full transformer stack to infer missing pieces from their left and right neighbors.
beats.visual_focus: A multi-layer Transformer stack showing bidirectional information propagation across all layers, filling in the masked gaps.
